program.address_context: Original unrelocated file-backed EE PT_LOAD; named M2 project copied from preserved M1 working project.

provenance.source: Read-only HGExport snapshots; authenticated against Japanese original ELF.
limitations: 12c790 and 12bd00 are reconstructed for their observed branches only; the other branches call a host fail-closed fault.
Math, rotation, look-at, strafe and node leaves remain original-instruction-modeled dependencies.

functions.name: hg_player_movement_gate
functions.interpretation: Movement gate: dispatch 15fe70, then report/clear +4ad for a selected +2c3.

functions.name: hg_player_movement
functions.interpretation: Movement/look dispatcher: counters, look or turn, walk, idle timers, heading from 70000b80/b90.

functions.name: hg_player_walk
functions.interpretation: Forward speed from left-stick Y 3eaf10, turn call, position advance by sin/cos of heading.

functions.name: hg_player_turn
functions.interpretation: Turn: left-stick X 3eaf0c level/row 39a3f0, rate +440 approach or decay, heading +44 = wrap(+44 - rate).

functions.name: hg_player_rate_approach
functions.interpretation: Rate approach toward a signed limit with opposite-sign braking; raw FP operands first.

functions.name: hg_player_speed_class
functions.interpretation: Speed class 1..3 from +4ad, +4d4, +416 and mode bit 4.

functions.name: hg_angle_wrap
functions.interpretation: Wrap an angle into (-pi, pi] by repeated EE add/subtract of 2*pi.

functions.name: hg_camera_update
functions.interpretation: Observed 3eaed4 == 0 branch only: node refresh, 12d130 follow, eye, view matrix; other branch fails closed.

functions.name: hg_camera_follow
functions.interpretation: Follow head matrix; without shake the eye/target pair is replaced before look-at 12c3d0.

functions.name: hg_camera_head_matrix
functions.interpretation: Observed +47a == 0 branch only: pitch/heading/roll head matrix, eye and target; other branch fails closed.
